notes.title: Stream Slugger Version 1.1.3
notes.content:
[b]Stream Slugger Version 1.1.3[/b]

[u][b]Important[/b][/u]
We had to reset the character levels because due to a major issue with level gains.

[u][b]Changes[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Character leveling now works as it should.
[*] The Storm Water Elemental character is now available in the dropdown list.
[*] There is now an option to show or hide the name when experience is gained in the settings menu.
[/list]
[url=https://www.youtube.com/@philberex]Follow on YouTube[/url]
[url=https://www.twitch.tv/philberex]Follow on Twitch[/url]

notes.title: Stream Slugger V1.1.2 live

notes.title: Chess Characters now ready to Slugger in v1.1.0!
notes.content:
[b]v1.1.0 Update Highlights:[/b]

[list]
[*] Stream Slugger now supports Chess Characters, making it easier to implement new character sets.
[*] Exciting news! More character sets are on the way!
[*] Introducing ground dust feature: Users can toggle it on or off in the settings menu.
[*] All chatters joining Stream Slugger now start with a base Level of 1, setting the stage for the upcoming "Character Leveling" update.
[/list]

[b]Now, there's a video tutorial for seamlessly integrating Stream Slugger into OBS for streaming.[/b]

Have Fun!
Regards,
Phil Berex.


[previewyoutube=kqizkpBSF5E;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]
